name: Lucky Dodge (Prayer)
body:
The gods of luck keep you out of harm’s way.

Prerequisites: Worshiping a deity with the Luck Domain

Benefit: You gain a +3 divine bonus to your Reflex save, once per day. If your base Reflex Save is at least +5, this bonus increases to +6.
